title: Anytime-Valid Conformal Risk Control
abstract: arXiv:2602.04364v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prediction sets provide a means of quantifying the uncertainty in predictive tasks. Using held out calibration data, conformal prediction and risk control can produce prediction sets that exhibit statistically valid error control in a computationally efficient manner. However, in the standard formulations, the error is only controlled on average over many possible calibration datasets of fixed size. In this paper, we extend the control to remain valid with high probability over a cumulatively growing calibration dataset at any time point. We derive such guarantees using quantile-based arguments and illustrate the applicability of the proposed framework to settings involving distribution shift. We further show that our guarantees are asymptotically tight, in the sense that the risks converge to the target level from below, and that the rate of our correction cannot be improved. translated_title: 任意时刻有效的保形风险控制
translated_abstract: 预测集为预测任务中的不确定性量化提供了一种手段。利用留出的校准数据，保形预测和风险控制能够以计算高效的方式生成具有统计上有效误差控制的预测集。然而，在标准形式中，误差仅在固定大小的多个可能校准数据集上进行平均控制。在本文中，我们将这种控制扩展为：随着校准数据集的累积增长，在任意时间点上都能以高概率保持有效。我们利用基于分位数的论证推导出此类保证，并说明了所提出框架在涉及分布偏移的情境中的适用性。我们进一步证明了这些保证是渐近紧的，即风险从下方收敛到目标水平，并且我们的修正速率无法再被改进。最后，我们展示了该方法的实际性能。
tldr: 本文提出了任意时刻有效的保形风险控制方法，将误差控制从固定大小校准数据集上的平均有效性扩展为随校准数据累积增长时在任意时刻均以高概率保持有效，并证明了该保证渐近紧致且修正速率不可再改进。
en_tdlr: This paper extends conformal risk control to anytime-valid guarantees, ensuring that error control remains valid with high probability at any time point as the calibration dataset accumulates, and proves that these guarantees are asymptotically tight with an unimprovable correction rate.
